blocks.text: Persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) cast their votes during the plebiscite in Naga City on Saturday, Nov. 21, on whether the city should be converted into a highly urbanized city. Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia said PDLs are entitled to participate in the plebiscite, as voting is among the rights they retain while in detention. —Photo by Comelec MANILA, Philippines — Persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) in Naga City took part in Saturday’s plebiscite on whether the city should be converted into a highly urbanized city (HUC), exercising their right to vote on a local issue.
